intro.fr: The Forged Curse se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: The Forged Curse can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub cheesepak/ap-forged-curse, qui héberge l'APWorld de The Forged Curse.
text.en: The GitHub repository cheesepak/ap-forged-curse, home of the The Forged Curse APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.1.0-beta.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (7 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.1.0-beta.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (7 versions released).

text.fr: The Forged Curse figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: The Forged Curse is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
